summary: Iter 17 — FINAL PRODUCTION-READINESS SWEEP. 34/34 tests PASS (40.25s) across the full regression stack (iter14 + iter15 + iter16 + new iter17). NEW iter17 coverage: (a) EPHEMERAL GATE verified end-to-end — a WS voice session with `ephemeral=true` produces ZERO delta in db.taccuino_timeline AND zero delta in db.taccuino_memories AND zero delta in db.taccuino_key_facts (direct pymongo count_documents pre/post assertion); (b) 5 sequential /api/profile calls return the identical Fabio doc (no oscillation between full/empty as originally reported); (c) `POST /api/confessional/reset` seeded with 3 rows returns {ok:true, deleted:3} and mongo confirms rows gone; empty-token case returns {ok:true, deleted:0}; (d) WS start+end no-audio → EXACTLY ONE synthetic done with reason='no_audio_received' in <12s (well under the 25s client timeout); (e) WS start+tiny-audio+ephemeral=false → exactly 1 done, no duplicates; (f) Auth: /api/auth/apple invalid=401, /api/auth/dev-login=200. Also fixed two stale iter14 assertions that hard-coded total_messages==634 (profile grew organically to 636 as Fabio kept using the app) — changed to `>=634` to match iter15/16/17 style. All prior fixes verified intact: (1) server.py:1610-1613 datetime coercion; (2) synthetic done + done_emitted flag in voice_stream.py:1186/1443/1785 preventing dupes; (3) ephemeral gates at server.py:9057-9077 (user entry + key_facts) AND server.py:10012-10077 (AI entry + profile.total_messages/memory_summary/core_traits/home_city + _save_memory) — all correctly gated by `if not ephemeral`. READY FOR PUBLISH.
